newsitem.title: USA: Palomar will appeal $3.1 mln judgement.
newsitem.headline: Palomar will appeal $3.1 mln judgement.

text.p: Palomar Medical Technologies Inc said Thursday it will appeal this week's federal magistrate's order awarding damages of $3.17 million to its former financial advisor, Commonwealth Associates, in its complaint against Palomar for breach of contract.
Palomar said that as of March 31 it has reserved $2.75 million in anticipation of possible costs associated with litigation matters, including the Commonwealth case.
The company said the suit centers on whether Commonwealth is owed certain fees.
Palomar Medical Technologies is a supplier of proprietary laser systems for dermatological and cosmetic laser treatment.
